# The mug with the awkward handle

The handle fits my fingers but not Nessa's. I made six nearly identical mugs and called that a consistent result. A larger loop might matter more than matching the glaze. Next session make three handles deliberately different and ask people to hold them while full of water. [[Pottery]] is an excellent place to discover that an aesthetic decision is also a physical demand.
